typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

question.description: The question for which the feedback is given.

serverVersion.description: Server version of the client Application.

chatHistory.description:
Chat history of the user with the assistant.
The elements of the array are in increasing order of time. i.e. last element is the most recent {@link AiAssistant.QAPair}.

client.description: The client service from which the feedback is given. Could be jupyter, VSCE, community, etc.

answers.description: List of upserted {@link AiAssistant.Feedback.Answer} given by the user for this query.

modelMetadata.description: Information regarding the model used for generating the response. See {@link AiAssistant.ModelMetadata}.

answerComparisons.description: List of comparisons of the {@link AiAssistant.Feedback.Answer} given by the user for this query.

title: The feedback given by the user for the answer given for a {@link AiAssistant.Feedback.Question#question} by the AI Assistant.
name: AiAssistant.Feedback.Question
